question: In a circle with radius 20 cm, X is a point located at a distance of 29 cm from the centre of the circle, what will be the length (in cm) of a tangent drawn from point X to the circle?
solution:
**Formula used:**

As per Pythagoras theorem , hypotenuse = √(base² + perpendicular² ) 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b514b8587bee80fc9cbdfd5661e8724811e007b95413744b6a01b79bbb6fce8.png] 

The length (in cm) of a tangent drawn from point X to the circle is 

⇒ √(29² - 20² )

⇒ √ (841 - 400) = √ (441)

⇒ 21 cm

**∴ The correct option is** **3**
